title: Luxury Hotel for Sale in Sant Antoni de Portmany, Spain
tagline: • Non-operational 3-star hotel asset in Sant Antoni de Portmany, Ibiza, positioned in a seafront location approximately 50 metres from the beach. • The property is situated mid-bay opposite the cultural area of Sa Punta des Molí, offering strong leisure visibility and sea-facing positioning. • The hotel comprises approximately 86 guestrooms, with all rooms offering sea views, spacious layouts, large terraces, extensive glazing, and large bathrooms. • The property extends across approximately 2,000 sq. m. of land with around 4,500 sq. m. of total built-up area, comprising six floors plus a principal/noble floor and a large basement. • Guest facilities include a swimming pool and solarium, buffet restaurant, cocktail bar with terrace, and a poolside bar. • Operational infrastructure includes a lift, service hoist, equipped kitchen with cold storage and refrigeration facilities, industrial laundry, Wi-Fi, and a waterproofed rooftop. • The hotel has been non-operational for the past couple of months and is available for a new owner to restart and reposition the property. • The property offers value-add potential through additional amenities such as a spa and parking, subject to applicable approvals and feasibility. • The combination of seafront positioning, established hotel infrastructure, sea-view guestrooms, and existing guest facilities provides a foundation for restarting and enhancing the hospitality operation. • Operates with a valid business license. All land documents and building permits are in place.
